description: SLOs, alerts, and error budgets for the deny-by-default multi-tenant webhook-subscription service. Tenant isolation is enforced by core.mjs owned() chokepoint; these SLOs keep the management API available, fast, and observable. No secret values are stored here.

slos.name: api-availability
slos.description: Fraction of HTTP requests that do NOT return a 5xx. 401/403 deny-by-default responses and 400 validation rejections are correct behavior and are excluded from the error SLI.

slos.name: subscription-read-latency-p99
slos.description: Fraction of GET /subscriptions evaluations served under the p99 latency target of 150ms. Reads are on the management hot path, so this budget is tight.

slos.name: subscription-write-latency-p99
slos.description: Fraction of POST/PUT /subscriptions writes (validate + mint/rotate secret + persist to data.json) served under the p99 latency target of 300ms.
